description:
Is this agent's reputation EARNED or BOUGHT? Origin verdict with reasons.

    THE FOLLOW-UP TO should_i_pay — explains WHY the verdict is CAUTION.
    Returns ORGANIC/BURST/FARM/MIXED/NONE + evidence: unique clients,
    burst-per-hour, ghost-wallet ratio, vouch-vs-earned feedback split.
    90%+ of Base ERC-8004 reviewers show coordinated sybil behavior (arXiv
    2606.26028) — this tool flags which agents' ratings are manufactured.
    By ERC-8004 agent_id or Solana asset. REST: GET /api/v1/reputation-origin ($0.02).

    Args:
        agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
        solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
name: reputation_origin
